Subject: Hosted API pricing — quick recap & next steps

Hi Asha / Ravi,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to hear more about Acme Health's roadmap for patient messaging and summarization features. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored hosted-API estimate: 

- Expected monthly token volume (rough ballpark you mentioned on the call): can you confirm an estimate (e.g., 10M / 50M / 100M+ tokens/month)?
- Token mix: what % do you expect to be generation (chat responses) vs. embeddings or classification?
- Peak concurrency / TPS: what peak requests-per-second should we size for? Any sustained vs. short burst expectations (e.g., 60s window)?
- Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens or target monthly budget range to help us propose pricing tiers?

I've attached our hosted API overview (Acme_Hosted_API_Deck.pdf) and a short template (ACME_pricing_request.xlsx) you can fill in if easier. Once we have the numbers we can share 1) a committed-pricing estimate that hits your unit target and 2) a non-committed usage price for comparison.

Proposed next step: 30-min price-ops sync early next week to review the estimate and any compliance/ingestion specifics. Are you available Tue/Wed mornings PT?

Thanks —
Ben Carter

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the follow-up and for the deck — helpful. Per our internal sizing exercise (high level):

- Expected monthly token volume: ~120M tokens/month (this is our current target for phase 1 across messaging + summarization).
- Token mix: ~85% generation (chat/assistant responses), ~10% embeddings (search indexing), ~5% other (classification/metadata).
- Average tokens per response: ~350 tokens (varies by endpoint), average prompt tokens ~150, so net per round-trip ~500 tokens on average.
- Peak TPS: we expect a steady-state peak around 6-8 TPS during business hours, with short bursts up to ~25-30 TPS for a few minutes during product launches.
- Budget range: we're planning for $6k–$12k/month initially, with flexibility if we can get strong unit economics; our procurement target is closer to ~$10k/mo for a managed hosted solution.
- Target $/1M tokens: ideally <= $10/1M tokens for generation-heavy usage, but we're open to committed discounts if that requires a monthly minimum.

Let me know if you need more granularity (per-endpoint breakdown) — I can ask Ravi to pull logs and give a distribution. Otherwise let's schedule the sync next week; Tue 10am PT works for me.

Best,
Asha
Product Lead, Acme Health
asha.patel@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — token volumes & peak TPS (Acme Health)

Asha — really helpful, thanks for the detail. A few quick clarifying Qs so we size and price properly: 

1) For the bursts to 25-30 TPS, how long do those typically last (seconds / minutes)? Do you have scheduled events that drive them (product announcements) or are they more unpredictable?
2) Are the embeddings runs (10%) batched as offline indexing jobs (lower priority) or are they low-latency calls that would need the same SLA as chat responses?
3) Any hard constraints on max latency for chat responses (P95 target)?

Prelim: based on 120M tokens/month and a generation-heavy mix, your target of <= $10/1M tokens is in the ballpark for committed pricing. Rough math: 120M tokens / 1M = 120 units; at $10/1M that's ~$1,200/month — (note: this number is illustrative and depends on how we classify prompt vs completion tokens and whether embeddings are charged differently). That said, for sustained 6-8 TPS and 30TPS bursts we may recommend a small committed Dedicated pool or a reserved throughput tier on Hosted to ensure consistent P95 latency; hosted committed plans include burst smoothing and a lower unit price.

I'll put together a few scenarios (month-to-month hosted, 6-month commit, and reserved throughput) with target unit prices that get you near $10/1M tokens. Marissa — looping you in to help with the pricing sheet and SOW template.

Thanks —
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Hi Asha / Ravi —

Thanks for the numbers, Asha — this is exactly what we need to build a formal estimate. I've attached a preliminary pricing worksheet (proposed_pricing_estimate.xlsx) with three scenarios:

1) Month-to-month Hosted (no commit) — higher unit price, flexible.
2) 6-month commit — reduced unit price targeting ~$9–$11/1M for generation depending on committed volume.
3) Reserved throughput (recommended if you need consistent P95 latency at 6-8 TPS with short bursts) — one-time setup + committed monthly throughput; unit price can get below $8/1M at higher commits.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm whether embeddings are tolerant of lower priority (we'll price them as batch if so)?
- If Tue 10am PT works, we'll book a 30-min call to review the worksheet and I'll bring our pricing ops contact to finalize contract terms.

Asha — I'll share the sheet now; Ben and I can iterate after your review.

Best,
